name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

```

        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL

        with:

          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}

        with:

          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none

          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder

        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:

        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:

      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

on:

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()

        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:

      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:

          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3

          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action

          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'

          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

    RUN apt-get update && \

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:

  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release

        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip

name: Release Builds

on:

      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    steps:

        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

      - name: Get composer cache directory
        id: composer-cache
        run: echo "::set-output name=dir::$(composer config cache-files-dir)"

      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4

          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

        run: composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: Run test suite
        run: vendor/bin/codecept run

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

    ```Dockerfile

    # Install git first, separately from other packages
    RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git

    # Install other relevant packages
    RUN apt-get update && \
        apt-get install -y zip unzip && \
        apt-get clean && \
        rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* || exit 0

    WORKDIR /app

    # Clone the repository
    RUN git clone https://github.com/getgrav/grav.git || exit 0

    WORKDIR /app/grav

    CMD ["/bin/bash"]

8. **Additional Suggestions**:

FROM php:8.3-cli

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git zip unzip libzip-dev libpng-dev && apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* || exit 0

# Install PHP extensions
RUN docker-php-ext-configure gd --with-freetype --with-jpeg && \
    docker-php-ext-install gd opcache zip || exit 0

WORKDIR /app

RUN git clone https://github.com/getgrav/grav.git && ls -la /app

WORKDIR /app/grav

RUN docker-php-ext-install zip gd

CMD ["/bin/bash"]

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:

          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}

          file_glob: true

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:

      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3

          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: PHP Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ develop ]

permissions:
  contents: read # to fetch code (actions/checkout)

jobs:

  unit-tests:

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    strategy:
      matrix:
        php: [8.3, 8.2, 8.1, 8.0, 7.4, 7.3]
        os: [ubuntu-latest]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

#      - name: Update composer
#        run: composer update
#
#      - name: Validate composer.json and composer.lock
#        run: composer validate

      - name: Get composer cache directory
        id: composer-cache
        run: echo "::set-output name=dir::$(composer config cache-files-dir)"

      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.composer-cache.outputs.dir }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: Run test suite
        run: vendor/bin/codecept run

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()

          fields: repo,message,author,action

          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()

          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3

          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

        );
        self::assertRegexp(

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:

      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:

          fields: repo,message,author,action

          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    name: Slack
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action@v2
      - uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: failure
          fields: repo,message,author,action
          icon_emoji: ':octocat:'
          author_name: 'Github Action Build'
          text: '🚚 Automated Build Failure'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION == 'failure'

name: Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write # for release creation (svenstaro/upload-release-action)

    if: "!github.event.release.prerelease"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Extract Tag
        run: echo "PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ github.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 7.3
          extensions: opcache, gd
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none
        env:
          COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get -y update -qq  < /dev/null > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get -y install -qq git zip < /dev/null > /dev/null

      - name: Retrieval of Builder Scripts
        run: |
          # Real Grav URL
          curl --silent -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GLOBAL_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

          # Development Local URL
          # curl ${{ secrets.BUILD_SCRIPT_URL }} --output build-grav.sh

      - name: Grav Builder
        run: |
          bash ./build-grav.sh

      - name: Upload packages to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ env.PACKAGE_VERSION }}
          file: ./grav-dist/*.zip
          overwrite: true
          file_glob: true

  slack:
    permissions:
      actions: read # to list jobs for workflow run (technote-space/workflow-conclusion-action)

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
